{"id": "62f8459d-0b08-4eaf-9ea9-397a5a30a8df", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "`HeaderSecretMismatched` means the CDN Authorization secret that MediaPackage v2 expects on incoming requests doesn't match the secret value your CDN is actually sending in the authorization header. This happens when:

- The secret stored in Secrets Manager (referenced by the endpoint's CDN auth config) has been rotated or changed, but the origin custom header on the CloudFront/CDN side wasn't updated to match
- The endpoint's CDN authorization was reconfigured to point at a different secret than what the distribution origin sends
- There's a stale cached distribution config still sending an old header value

To pin down exactly where the mismatch is, I'd need to compare the secret value configured on your MediaPackage v2 origin endpoint's authorization against the custom header value your CDN origin is actually sending.

Can you give me the origin endpoint identifier (channel group / channel / endpoint name or ARN) and the CloudFront distribution ID (or CDN) in front of it? I'll check whether the secret values line up and tell you what to fix.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
